limitations: No Credit Agreement, indenture or Exhibit 22.1 in the corpus: CP-4 covenant terms rest on 10-K/10-Q descriptions; the term-loan borrower comes from the 10-K exhibit index.
Covenant text read in all four filings was identical (7.50x springing test, 7.25x and 5.00x incurrence tests); only the 2024-12-28 filing is cited.

Debt-stack table total (24,578) excludes the securitization facility; the debt maturity schedule (10-K, 2024-09-30) excludes finance leases and the securitization facility; no 2024-12-28 schedule is printed.

The MD&A non-GAAP paragraph says the revolver covenant measures secured indebtedness to Consolidated EBITDA, while the covenant paragraph says net debt to EBITDA As Defined; the ratio_definition fact is marked conflicting (both quotes, null value).
Revolver drawn balance is derived (commitments less letters of credit less availability), and the Note 8 table has no revolver line; the filings do not print a drawn amount.
The FY2024 annual-report PDF is listed nowhere as a source and was not parsed.
Hedging instruments, interest swaps and leases beyond the finance-lease balance are not covered.

The Credit Agreement and indentures are not in the corpus; context.json sets attachments.legal_documents to 'executed' (form default, per ruling G-6) and CP-4 covenant facts come from the filed 10-K/10-Q descriptions only.
